envelope.description: The review subject is the Story's own files, with its attribution recorded

body.title: The review subject is the Story's own files, with its attribution recorded
body.summary: changedFiles (src/workflow/runners/build/changed-files.ts:143-150) takes storyKey: with 'story-trailer' attribution the committed paths are the retained units' paths (exclusions kept), not the net range narrowed to them. resolveCodeReviewSubject (src/workflow/code-review/subject.ts:119-175) passes `<epicHash>/<storyId>` on the range-base attempt and sets changeSetAttribution ('working-tree' for the dirty-tree path) and sharedWithExcluded on the subject; the runner's record writer (src/workflow/code-review/runner.ts:289-292) persists both. Types in src/workflow/code-review/types.ts.
acceptanceChecks: The subject holds only the Story's own files and records 'story-trailer'.
A file the Story changed and another Story reverted stays in the subject.
A dirty tree gives 'working-tree'; the step-down order is unchanged.
The code-review record carries changeSetAttribution and sharedWithExcluded.
